about: Which skills each stage reads by default. A key is a stage id (every recipe) or <recipe>/<stage> (that recipe only, which wins); a value is a list of skill names (craft/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, or the user's own in data/craft/skills/). "studio" is the Studio page's own turns (every recipe). This file is the built-in set "Default"; the user's own sets (data/craft/skill-sets/) use the same keys, and a key there replaces the shipped list for that stage.
